no-achievements: This game has no Steam achievements.
profile-help: In Steam, open your profile, right-click and choose Copy Page URL.
profile-passive: Switch to Interactive mode to enter your Steam profile.
profile-invalid: This is not a Steam profile link. Example: steamcommunity.com/id/yourname
profile-notfound: No Steam profile at this link. Check it and try again.
nothing: Play a Steam game: its achievements show up here.
profile-help-short: Steam: your profile › right-click › Copy Page URL

pick-hint: Up to 3. They stay at the top of the widget.
pick-full: Limit reached: untick one to add another.

hidden-profile: Steam hides your profile. Set it to Public, and your game details too.
hidden-path: In Steam: Profile › Edit Profile › Privacy Settings
hidden-profile-setting: My profile and Game details: Public
